words.enDefinition: A rectangular arrangement of entries in rows and columns.

examples.en: We wrote a matrix showing how many parts each group needed for its two models.
examples.zh: 我们写了一个「矩阵」，表示各组制作两个模型分别需要多少零件。

examples.en: The tutor drew a matrix on the board before explaining how its entries were indexed.
examples.zh: 老师先在黑板上画了一个「矩阵」，再解释怎样用索引表示其中的元素。

words.enDefinition: The value at a specified row and column of a matrix.

examples.en: We located the matrix entry in the second row and third column of the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在练习表上找到了第二行第三列的「矩阵元素」。

examples.en: Our tutor changed one matrix entry so we could see which answers were affected.
examples.zh: 老师改动了一个「矩阵元素」，让我们看出哪些结果会受到影响。

words.enDefinition: The numbers of rows and columns in a matrix, stated in that order.

examples.en: We stated the matrix dimensions as three by four before looking for possible products.
examples.zh: 在寻找哪些乘积可以计算之前，我们注明「矩阵的行列数」为三行四列。

examples.en: The tutor checked the matrix dimensions after we added another column to the example.
examples.zh: 我们给例题增添一列后，老师核对了「矩阵的行列数」。

collocations: compare the matrix dimensions before multiplying

words.enDefinition: A matrix with the same number of rows and columns.

examples.en: The first example used a square matrix because it had three rows and three columns.
examples.zh: 第一个例题用了一个「方阵」，因为它有三行三列。

examples.en: We selected a square matrix from the worksheet before finding its determinant in class.
examples.zh: 我们先从练习表中选取一个「方阵」，再在课堂上求它的行列式。

collocations: take the determinant of a square matrix

words.enDefinition: A matrix whose numbers of rows and columns differ.

examples.en: The diagram showed a nonsquare matrix with a different number of inputs and outputs.
examples.zh: 图中显示了一个「非方阵」，它对应的输入数和输出数不同。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the transpose of a nonsquare matrix had a different shape.
examples.zh: 老师问，为什么「非方阵」转置后形状会发生变化。

collocations: multiply a nonsquare matrix by a vector

words.enDefinition: A vector represented as a matrix with one row.

examples.en: We wrote the recorded scores as a row vector with one position for each quiz.
examples.zh: 我们把记录的分数写成「行向量」，每次小测各占一个位置。

examples.en: The example changed a column of measurements into a row vector before multiplying it.
examples.zh: 例题先把一列测量数据改写为「行向量」，再进行乘法运算。

collocations: multiply a row vector by a matrix

words.enDefinition: A vector represented as a matrix with one column.

examples.en: We arranged the unknown values in a column vector before writing the matrix equation.
examples.zh: 写出矩阵方程之前，我们把未知量排成一个「列向量」。

examples.en: The tutor used a column vector to list the quantities one below the other.
examples.zh: 老师用「列向量」把各个数量竖着排列。

collocations: multiply a matrix by a column vector

words.enDefinition: A matrix with every entry equal to zero.

examples.en: Subtracting the table of values from itself gave us a zero matrix in the example.
examples.zh: 例题里，用这张数值表减去它自身，得到了一个「零矩阵」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked for a zero matrix with the same dimensions as the original.
examples.zh: 老师要求写出一个与原矩阵行列数相同的「零矩阵」。

words.enDefinition: A square matrix with ones on its main diagonal and zeros everywhere else.

examples.en: We multiplied by the identity matrix and obtained exactly the same entries as before.
examples.zh: 我们乘以「单位矩阵」后，得到的元素与原来完全相同。

examples.en: The tutor wrote the identity matrix beside the original square matrix before starting elimination.
examples.zh: 老师把「单位矩阵」写在原方阵旁边，再开始消元。

collocations: reduce a matrix to the identity matrix

words.enDefinition: The sequence of entries whose row and column numbers are equal.

examples.en: We marked the main diagonal before checking which entries remained in the same positions after transposing.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「主对角线」，再核对哪些元素转置后仍留在原处。

examples.en: The main diagonal of the example contained three numbers, with a zero in the middle.
examples.zh: 例题的「主对角线」有三个数，中间是零。

words.enDefinition: An entry whose row and column numbers are equal.

examples.en: We changed the second diagonal entry and then recalculated the determinant of the small matrix.
examples.zh: 我们改了第二个「对角元素」，随后重新计算这个小矩阵的行列式。

examples.en: The last diagonal entry was zero, so the triangular matrix had determinant zero in the example.
examples.zh: 例题里最后一个「对角元素」为零，所以这个三角矩阵的行列式为零。

words.enDefinition: A square matrix whose entries outside the main diagonal are all zero.

examples.en: The example used a diagonal matrix to scale each coordinate by its own factor.
examples.zh: 例题用「对角矩阵」将各个坐标分别按各自的倍数缩放。

examples.en: We checked the entries away from the main diagonal before calling it a diagonal matrix.
examples.zh: 我们先检查主对角线以外的元素，再判断它是不是「对角矩阵」。

words.enDefinition: A square matrix with every entry below its main diagonal equal to zero.

examples.en: We obtained an upper triangular matrix after eliminating the entries below each pivot in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们消掉各主元下方的元素后得到了一个「上三角矩阵」。

examples.en: The last equation was easy to solve because the coefficients formed an upper triangular matrix.
examples.zh: 系数构成「上三角矩阵」，因此最后一个方程很容易解。

collocations: reduce to an upper triangular matrix
solve a system with an upper triangular matrix
the determinant of an upper triangular matrix

words.enDefinition: A square matrix with every entry above its main diagonal equal to zero.

examples.en: We identified a lower triangular matrix by checking that all entries above the diagonal were zero.
examples.zh: 我们检查了对角线上方的元素都为零，认出这是一个「下三角矩阵」。

examples.en: Our tutor transposed a lower triangular matrix to show where the zeros moved in the example.
examples.zh: 老师将一个「下三角矩阵」转置，展示例题中零元素移到了哪些位置。

words.enDefinition: A square matrix whose entries on one side of the main diagonal are all zero.

examples.en: The tutor used a triangular matrix to calculate the determinant from only its diagonal entries.
examples.zh: 老师用一个「三角矩阵」举例，只用它的对角元素计算行列式。

examples.en: We checked both sides of the diagonal before classifying the example as a triangular matrix.
examples.zh: 把例题矩阵归为「三角矩阵」前，我们先检查了对角线两侧。

collocations: calculate the determinant of a triangular matrix
solve equations with a triangular matrix

words.enDefinition: A square matrix equal to its own transpose.

examples.en: We compared the entries across the main diagonal before calling the example a symmetric matrix.
examples.zh: 把例题中的矩阵称为「对称矩阵」之前，我们先比较了主对角线两侧成对的元素。

examples.en: Our tutor changed one entry and asked what else must change to preserve the symmetric matrix.
examples.zh: 老师改动一个元素后问，还要改什么才能保持它是「对称矩阵」。

collocations: check whether a matrix is symmetric
compare paired entries of a symmetric matrix

words.enDefinition: The matrix obtained by exchanging the rows and columns of the original matrix.

examples.en: The matrix transpose had four rows because the original arrangement contained four columns.
examples.zh: 「矩阵的转置」有四行，因为原矩阵有四列。

examples.en: We checked the position of the first entry after writing the matrix transpose in our notes.
examples.zh: 我们在笔记里写出「矩阵的转置」后，核对了第一个元素的位置。

collocations: compare a matrix transpose with the original

words.enDefinition: Adding corresponding entries of two matrices with the same dimensions.

examples.en: We used matrix addition to combine the quantities recorded by two groups in the same layout.
examples.zh: 我们用「矩阵加法」合并两组按同样版式记录的数量。

examples.en: The tutor ruled out matrix addition because one table had an extra column.
examples.zh: 其中一张表多出一列，因此老师排除了使用「矩阵加法」。

collocations: use matrix addition to combine two tables

words.enDefinition: Subtracting corresponding entries of two matrices with the same dimensions.

examples.en: The exercise used matrix subtraction to show how the quantities changed from the first week.
examples.zh: 练习用「矩阵减法」展示数量相对于第一周有何变化。

examples.en: We checked the order of the two matrices before doing the matrix subtraction.
examples.zh: 进行「矩阵减法」前，我们先核对了两个矩阵的顺序。

words.enDefinition: Multiplying every entry of a matrix by the same scalar.

examples.en: The scalar multiplication of a matrix by three tripled every entry in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂例题中，以三为标量做「矩阵的数乘」，每个元素都变为原来的三倍。

examples.en: Our tutor illustrated scalar multiplication of a matrix before combining it with another matrix of matching size.
examples.zh: 老师先演示了「矩阵的数乘」，再将结果与另一个同样大小的矩阵相加。

collocations: perform scalar multiplication of a matrix
check scalar multiplication of a matrix entry by entry
use scalar multiplication of a matrix to rescale entries

words.enDefinition: Multiplying matrices by summing pairwise products of corresponding entries in each selected row and column.

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated matrix multiplication by beginning with the first row and the second column.
examples.zh: 老师从第一行和第二列开始演示「矩阵乘法」。

examples.en: We checked the dimensions before attempting matrix multiplication in the order given on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 按练习表给出的顺序进行「矩阵乘法」之前，我们先核查了行列数。

collocations: check the inner dimensions for matrix multiplication
reverse the order of matrix multiplication

words.enDefinition: The resulting matrix obtained when compatible matrices are multiplied in a specified order.

examples.en: The matrix product had three rows from the first matrix and two columns from the second.
examples.zh: 「矩阵乘积」有三行，由第一个矩阵决定，也有两列，由第二个矩阵决定。

examples.en: Our partner found a different matrix product after reversing the order of the same two factors.
examples.zh: 我们同伴交换了相同两个因子的顺序，得到不同的「矩阵乘积」。

collocations: write the dimensions of a matrix product

words.enDefinition: The column vector formed by multiplying a matrix by a compatible column vector.

examples.en: We interpreted the matrix-vector product as a weighted sum of the three columns on the board.
examples.zh: 我们把「矩阵与向量的乘积」解释为黑板上三列的加权和。

examples.en: The worksheet checked whether the matrix-vector product matched the displayed right-hand side of the equation.
examples.zh: 练习表检查了「矩阵与向量的乘积」是否与方程所列右端项一致。

collocations: express a matrix-vector product as a column combination

words.enDefinition: Forming a product by placing the multiplying factor on the left of a specified matrix or vector.

examples.en: The example used left multiplication by an elementary matrix to swap two rows of the original.
examples.zh: 例题用初等矩阵对原矩阵进行「左乘」，从而交换原矩阵的两行。

examples.en: We marked the multiplying factor before comparing the effects of left multiplication on the two examples.
examples.zh: 我们先标记乘数矩阵，再比较两个例题中的「左乘」效果。

collocations: apply left multiplication by an elementary matrix
compare left multiplication with right multiplication

words.enDefinition: Forming a product by placing the multiplying factor on the right of a specified matrix.

examples.en: In the worksheet, right multiplication by a permutation matrix rearranged the columns of the original matrix.
examples.zh: 练习表中，用一个置换矩阵进行「右乘」会重新排列原矩阵的各列。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether right multiplication was defined for the pair of rectangular matrices shown.
examples.zh: 老师问，对图中这对矩形矩阵进行「右乘」是否有定义。

collocations: apply right multiplication by a permutation matrix
compare the results of right multiplication

words.enDefinition: Matrix sizes meeting the requirements for the operation under consideration.

examples.en: We checked for compatible dimensions by matching the first matrix's columns with the second matrix's rows.
examples.zh: 我们对比第一个矩阵的列数与第二个矩阵的行数，检查是否为「相容的行列数」。

examples.en: The two tables had compatible dimensions for addition, with three rows and two columns each.
examples.zh: 两张表都是三行两列，所以对于加法来说具有「相容的行列数」。

collocations: verify compatible dimensions before forming a product

words.enDefinition: Multiplication for which changing the order of factors can change the result.

examples.en: The class illustrated noncommutative multiplication by obtaining different matrices from the same factors in opposite orders.
examples.zh: 全班把相同因子按相反顺序相乘，得出不同矩阵，用来说明「不满足交换律的乘法」。

examples.en: Our tutor gave an example of noncommutative multiplication using two small square matrices.
examples.zh: 老师用两个小方阵演示了「不满足交换律的乘法」。

words.enDefinition: A square matrix multiplied by itself as many times as specified by a positive integer exponent

examples.en: The worksheet rewrote the matrix power with exponent three as a product of three identical factors.
examples.zh: 练习表将指数为三的「矩阵的幂」改写为三个相同因子的乘积。

examples.en: We calculated the matrix power by multiplying the same square matrix several times in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上将同一个方阵连续相乘，算出了「矩阵的幂」。

collocations: find a matrix power by repeated multiplication
write a matrix power in expanded form

words.enDefinition: A matrix partitioned into smaller rectangular submatrices called blocks.

examples.en: The tutor used a block matrix to keep the two groups of variables visibly separate.
examples.zh: 老师用「分块矩阵」把两组变量清楚地分开。

examples.en: We checked the sizes of the pieces before rewriting the original example as a block matrix.
examples.zh: 在将原例题改写为「分块矩阵」前，我们核查了各部分的大小。

collocations: multiply compatible blocks of a block matrix

words.enDefinition: The matrix formed by multiplying a column vector by a row vector.

examples.en: We formed an outer product from a column of quantities and a row of conversion factors.
examples.zh: 我们用一列数量和一行换算系数形成「外积」。

examples.en: The outer product had one row for each entry of the column vector we started with.
examples.zh: 原列向量的每个元素都对应「外积」的一行。

collocations: express a matrix as an outer product
inspect an entry of the outer product

words.enDefinition: A matrix obtained by applying one elementary row operation to an identity matrix.

examples.en: We constructed an elementary matrix by adding a multiple of one identity row to another.
examples.zh: 我们把单位矩阵一行的倍数加到另一行，构造了一个「初等矩阵」。

examples.en: The tutor used an elementary matrix to track a single step of the elimination process.
examples.zh: 老师用一个「初等矩阵」记录消元过程中的单个步骤。

collocations: an elementary matrix for a row swap

words.enDefinition: A square matrix obtained by rearranging the rows or columns of an identity matrix.

examples.en: The example used a permutation matrix to change the order of the rows in one product.
examples.zh: 例题用「置换矩阵」改变某个乘积的行顺序。

examples.en: We checked that the permutation matrix had exactly one entry equal to one in each column.
examples.zh: 我们核查了「置换矩阵」每列恰有一个元素等于一。

collocations: swap rows using a permutation matrix

words.enDefinition: An equation equating a weighted sum of unknowns to a constant.

examples.en: We wrote a linear equation relating the total number of parts to the two unknown quantities.
examples.zh: 我们写了一个「线性方程」，把零件总数与两个未知数量联系起来。

examples.en: The tutor checked whether the proposed values satisfied the linear equation on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 老师核查所提议的数值是否满足练习表上的「线性方程」。

collocations: check an answer to a linear equation

words.enDefinition: Several linear equations considered together for the same unknowns.

examples.en: We wrote a system of linear equations to represent the constraints on three material quantities.
examples.zh: 我们写了一个「线性方程组」，表示对三种材料数量的约束。

examples.en: The tutor checked each value against the entire system of linear equations in our example.
examples.zh: 老师将各个数值代入例题的整个「线性方程组」进行核对。

collocations: write a system of linear equations
solve a system of linear equations
represent a system of linear equations with a matrix

words.enDefinition: The matrix containing the coefficients of the unknowns in a linear system.

examples.en: We wrote the coefficient matrix with one row per equation and one column per unknown.
examples.zh: 我们写出「系数矩阵」，每个方程对应一行，每个未知量对应一列。

examples.en: The coefficient matrix stayed unchanged when the tutor replaced only the right-hand side in the exercise.
examples.zh: 老师只替换了练习的右端项，「系数矩阵」保持原样。

collocations: find the rank of the coefficient matrix
read coefficients from the coefficient matrix

words.enDefinition: The column vector of constants on the right sides of a linear system.

examples.en: We placed the right-hand side vector after the columns containing coefficients of the unknowns.
examples.zh: 我们把「右端项向量」放在包含未知量系数的各列之后。

examples.en: Our tutor changed the right-hand side vector and asked whether the system still had a solution.
examples.zh: 老师改了「右端项向量」，问方程组是否仍然有解。

words.enDefinition: A matrix made by adjoining the right-hand side to the coefficient matrix of a system.

examples.en: We drew a vertical line inside the augmented matrix to separate the coefficients from the constants.
examples.zh: 我们在「增广矩阵」里画了一条竖线，把系数和常数分隔开。

examples.en: The tutor performed elimination on the augmented matrix so the right-hand side changed along with the coefficients.
examples.zh: 老师在「增广矩阵」上消元，所以右端项随系数一起变化。

collocations: interpret the last column of an augmented matrix

words.enDefinition: An ordered vector of values that satisfies all the equations in a system.

examples.en: We checked the solution vector by substituting its entries into every equation from the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把向量中的各个值代入练习表的每个方程，核查「解向量」。

examples.en: The last entry of the solution vector represented the number of pieces needed from the third group.
examples.zh: 「解向量」的最后一个元素表示需要第三组提供多少个零件。

collocations: substitute a solution vector into the system

words.enDefinition: The set of all values or vectors satisfying the stated equations.

examples.en: We wrote the solution set using a parameter because one variable could take any real value.
examples.zh: 一个变量可以取任意实数，因此我们用参数表示「解集」。

examples.en: The tutor looked for another solution set after changing one constant in the original equations.
examples.zh: 老师改变了原方程组中的一个常数，再求新的「解集」。

collocations: write a solution set in parametric form

words.enDefinition: A linear system whose right-hand side consists entirely of zeros.

examples.en: The class observed that every homogeneous system has a solution with all unknowns equal to zero.
examples.zh: 全班注意到，每个「齐次线性方程组」都有一个所有未知量都等于零的解。

examples.en: We checked whether the homogeneous system had any solutions besides the one with all zero entries.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「齐次线性方程组」除所有分量均为零的解之外是否还有别的解。

collocations: find a nonzero solution of a homogeneous system

words.enDefinition: A linear system with at least one nonzero constant on the right-hand side.

examples.en: The example became a nonhomogeneous system when the tutor changed one right-hand side entry to five.
examples.zh: 老师把右端项中的一个分量改成五后，例题变成了「非齐次线性方程组」。

examples.en: We compared the nonhomogeneous system with the one that used the same coefficients and zero constants.
examples.zh: 我们把「非齐次线性方程组」与系数相同且常数都为零的方程组作了比较。

collocations: check consistency of a nonhomogeneous system

words.enDefinition: The solution of a homogeneous linear system in which every unknown is zero.

examples.en: We substituted zeros for every unknown to verify the trivial solution in the homogeneous example.
examples.zh: 我们将各未知量都替换成零，验证齐次例题中的「平凡解」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the system had another solution in addition to the trivial solution.
examples.zh: 老师问，方程组除了「平凡解」之外还有没有别的解。

collocations: distinguish the trivial solution from other solutions

words.enDefinition: A solution of a homogeneous linear system with at least one nonzero component.

examples.en: We found a nontrivial solution by choosing a nonzero value for one free variable.
examples.zh: 我们为一个自由变量选择非零值，找到了一个「非平凡解」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked that the nontrivial solution satisfied all the equations on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 老师核查这个「非平凡解」满足练习表上的所有方程。

words.enDefinition: A system of equations having at least one solution.

examples.en: The worksheet identified a consistent system because at least one vector satisfied all its equations.
examples.zh: 练习表将它判为「相容方程组」，因为至少有一个向量满足它的所有方程。

examples.en: We checked whether the final example was a consistent system before introducing any free parameters.
examples.zh: 引入任何自由参数前，我们先核查最后一个例题是否为「相容方程组」。

collocations: check whether the example is a consistent system

words.enDefinition: A system of equations having no common solution.

examples.en: The inconsistent system required the same expression to equal two different numbers at once.
examples.zh: 该「不相容方程组」要求同一个表达式同时等于两个不同的数。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed to the contradictory row before calling the example an inconsistent system.
examples.zh: 老师先指出矛盾行，再把例题判为「不相容方程组」。

collocations: explain why the equations form an inconsistent system

words.enDefinition: The only solution satisfying all the equations in a system.

examples.en: The example had a unique solution because no variable remained free after the elimination.
examples.zh: 消元后没有自由变量，例题因此有「唯一解」。

examples.en: We verified the unique solution by finding a pivot in every variable column of the consistent system.
examples.zh: 我们在相容方程组中每个变量列都找到了主元，据此验证存在「唯一解」。

collocations: check whether there is a unique solution

words.enDefinition: A solution set with infinitely many distinct choices, possible in a consistent linear system with free variables over the reals.

examples.en: The system had infinitely many solutions because one free variable could take any real value.
examples.zh: 一个自由变量可以取任意实数，这个方程组因此有「无穷多个解」。

examples.en: We represented infinitely many solutions with a vector expression containing two independent parameters.
examples.zh: 我们用含两个独立参数的向量表达式表示「无穷多个解」。

collocations: show that a system has infinitely many solutions
describe infinitely many solutions using parameters

words.enDefinition: One permitted row change: swapping two rows, scaling one by a nonzero scalar, or adding a multiple of another.

examples.en: The tutor recorded each elementary row operation so we could retrace the elimination later.
examples.zh: 老师记下每次「初等行变换」，方便我们之后重走消元过程。

examples.en: We checked which elementary row operation would create a zero below the leading entry.
examples.zh: 我们检查哪种「初等行变换」能在首个非零元素下方得到零。

words.enDefinition: An elementary row operation exchanging the positions of two rows.

examples.en: We used a row interchange to bring a nonzero entry into the first pivot position.
examples.zh: 我们用「行交换」把一个非零元素移到第一个主元位置。

examples.en: The tutor recorded the row interchange before continuing the computation of the determinant.
examples.zh: 老师记录了「行交换」，然后继续计算行列式。

collocations: track the sign change from a row interchange

words.enDefinition: To multiply every entry of a row by the same nonzero scalar in an elementary row operation.

examples.en: We chose to scale a row by one half to make its leading entry equal one.
examples.zh: 我们按法则「给一行乘以非零数」，用二分之一让首个非零元素变成一。

examples.en: The tutor asked which factor would scale a row without changing the system's solution set.
examples.zh: 老师问，「给一行乘以非零数」时应取哪个数，才能保持方程组的解集不变。

collocations: scale a row by a nonzero number
scale a row to obtain a leading one
scale a row of the augmented matrix

words.enDefinition: Replacing a row by itself plus a scalar multiple of another row.

examples.en: The row replacement added twice the first row to the second in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习表的「行倍加变换」把第一行的两倍加到第二行。

examples.en: We used row replacement to eliminate the coefficient under the pivot in the first column.
examples.zh: 我们用「行倍加变换」消掉第一列主元下方的系数。

collocations: eliminate an entry using row replacement

words.enDefinition: The relation between matrices when elementary row operations transform one into the other.

examples.en: We showed row equivalence by listing the steps that changed the first matrix into the second.
examples.zh: 我们列出将第一个矩阵变为第二个的步骤，证明它们「行等价」。

examples.en: The tutor used row equivalence to explain why the two augmented matrices represented the same solutions.
examples.zh: 老师用「行等价」解释这两个增广矩阵为什么表示相同的解。

words.enDefinition: A method using elementary row operations to reduce a linear system to echelon form before solving it

examples.en: We used Gaussian elimination to remove the entries below successive pivots in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂例题中用「高斯消元法」逐个消掉主元下方的元素。

examples.en: The tutor showed how Gaussian elimination exposed a contradiction in one row of the system.
examples.zh: 老师演示了「高斯消元法」怎样揭示方程组某一行中的矛盾。

collocations: solve a system by Gaussian elimination
record the pivots during Gaussian elimination

words.enDefinition: The stage of elimination that clears entries below successive pivots to create echelon form.

examples.en: We finished forward elimination before solving the last equation for its only remaining unknown.
examples.zh: 我们完成「前向消元」后，才解最后一个方程里仅剩的未知量。

examples.en: The tutor highlighted the entries that became zero during forward elimination in the small system.
examples.zh: 老师标出了这个小型方程组在「前向消元」中变为零的元素。

collocations: record the result of forward elimination

words.enDefinition: Solving an echelon system from the last equation upward by substituting values already obtained.

examples.en: We used back substitution to find the other values after solving the last equation.
examples.zh: 我们解出最后一个方程后，用「回代」求得其他未知量的值。

examples.en: The tutor checked the second equation after our back substitution gave a different result from the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们的「回代」结果与练习表不同，老师于是核查了第二个方程。

collocations: solve the remaining equations by back substitution
check the results of back substitution

words.enDefinition: A row-reduction method that makes pivots equal to one and clears both above and below each pivot.

examples.en: The example used Gauss-Jordan elimination to clear all nonpivot entries from the pivot columns.
examples.zh: 例题用「高斯—若尔当消元法」消掉主元列中主元之外的非零元素。

examples.en: We compared Gauss-Jordan elimination with the shorter route that stopped at echelon form before back substitution.
examples.zh: 我们对比了「高斯—若尔当消元法」和在阶梯形处停下来再回代的步骤较少的方法。

collocations: reduce a matrix with Gauss-Jordan elimination
solve a system by Gauss-Jordan elimination

words.enDefinition: Using elementary row operations to simplify a matrix, often to echelon or reduced echelon form.

examples.en: The worksheet showed each step of row reduction rather than giving only the final matrix.
examples.zh: 练习表逐步写出「行化简」，没有只给最终矩阵。

examples.en: We recorded the operations used in row reduction so our partner could check the arithmetic.
examples.zh: 我们记下了「行化简」所用的操作，方便同伴核对计算。

collocations: show the steps of row reduction
check an error during row reduction

words.enDefinition: A matrix form with zero rows last and successive leading entries farther right in lower nonzero rows.

examples.en: The matrix reached row echelon form with leading entries stepping right and zero rows last.
examples.zh: 矩阵的各行首个非零元素依次右移，零行在最下方，因此达到「行阶梯形」。

examples.en: Our tutor placed the all-zero row at the bottom when writing the matrix in row echelon form.
examples.zh: 老师把全零行放在最下方，将矩阵写成「行阶梯形」。

collocations: read pivots from row echelon form

words.enDefinition: Row echelon form in which each leading entry is one and the only nonzero entry in its column.

examples.en: We reached reduced row echelon form after making each pivot one and clearing its column.
examples.zh: 我们把各主元变成一，并消掉它所在列的其他非零元素后，得到「简化行阶梯形」。

examples.en: The tutor used reduced row echelon form to read the pivot variables directly from the matrix.
examples.zh: 老师用「简化行阶梯形」直接从矩阵读出主元变量。

collocations: find the reduced row echelon form
write the augmented matrix in reduced row echelon form

words.enDefinition: The first nonzero entry from the left in a nonzero row.

examples.en: We circled the leading entry in each nonzero row before checking the staircase pattern.
examples.zh: 我们先圈出各非零行的「行首非零元素」，再核查是否呈阶梯状。

examples.en: The tutor scaled the row to make its leading entry one in the worked example.
examples.zh: 老师在例题中对该行做数乘，使其「行首非零元素」等于一。

collocations: identify the leading entry of a row
make a leading entry equal to one

words.enDefinition: A position corresponding to a leading entry in an echelon form of the matrix.

examples.en: In this example the first pivot position was in column two because column one contained zeros.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，第一列全是零，因此第一个「主元位置」在第二列。

examples.en: We marked each pivot position before counting how many independent constraints the system imposed.
examples.zh: 我们先标出各「主元位置」，再统计该系统有多少独立约束。

words.enDefinition: A column whose index corresponds to a pivot position in an echelon form.

examples.en: We selected each pivot column from the original matrix to form a basis for its column space.
examples.zh: 我们从原矩阵取出每个「主元列」，用来组成它的列空间的一组基。

examples.en: The tutor marked the pivot column before asking which variable it represented in the system.
examples.zh: 老师先标出「主元列」，再问它在方程组中代表哪个变量。

words.enDefinition: An unknown corresponding to a pivot column of the coefficient matrix.

examples.en: The tutor expressed each pivot variable in terms of the remaining unknowns in the worked example.
examples.zh: 老师在例题中把每个「主元变量」表示为其余未知量的函数。

examples.en: We checked which pivot variable appeared in the second equation after elimination.
examples.zh: 我们查看了消元后第二个方程里出现了哪个「主元变量」。

collocations: write a pivot variable in terms of free variables

words.enDefinition: An unknown whose column has no pivot and whose value can be chosen freely in a consistent linear system.

examples.en: We used a free variable as a parameter because its value was not fixed by any pivot.
examples.zh: 我们把一个「自由变量」用作参数，因为没有任何主元限定它的值。

examples.en: Changing the free variable gave us a different solution without violating the equations in the example.
examples.zh: 改变「自由变量」后，我们得到一个不同的解，而且仍满足例题的各个方程。

collocations: assign a value to a free variable
write the solution in terms of a free variable

words.enDefinition: A solution set written as a fixed vector plus linear combinations of direction vectors with free parameters.

examples.en: We wrote the solution in parametric vector form to show how each free variable changed the result.
examples.zh: 我们把解写成「参数向量形式」，展示每个自由变量怎样改变结果。

examples.en: The tutor checked the fixed vector and both direction vectors in our parametric vector form.
examples.zh: 老师核查了我们「参数向量形式」中的固定向量和两个方向向量。

collocations: write a solution in parametric vector form
convert a description to parametric vector form

words.enDefinition: One specific solution of a system, used as a starting point for describing all solutions.

examples.en: We found a particular solution by setting the free variables to zero in the consistent example.
examples.zh: 我们在相容的例题中将自由变量设为零，得到一个「特解」。

examples.en: The tutor checked the particular solution before adding the possible homogeneous solutions to it.
examples.zh: 老师核查了「特解」，才将齐次方程组的各种解与它相加。

collocations: add a homogeneous solution to a particular solution

words.enDefinition: A description expressing every solution of an equation or system.

examples.en: We wrote the general solution by adding an arbitrary homogeneous solution to one particular solution.
examples.zh: 我们把任意一个齐次解加到一个特解上，写出了「通解」。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether our general solution included every value of the two free variables.
examples.zh: 老师问，我们的「通解」是否包含两个自由变量可取的全部值。

collocations: describe the general solution with parameters

words.enDefinition: An equation in which a matrix or matrix operation appears.

examples.en: We wrote a matrix equation with the coefficient matrix multiplying the vector of unknowns.
examples.zh: 我们写出一个「矩阵方程」，左端是系数矩阵乘以未知量向量。

examples.en: The tutor checked the matrix equation before beginning the elimination steps on the board.
examples.zh: 老师核查了「矩阵方程」，才开始在黑板上做消元。

collocations: translate a system into a matrix equation

words.enDefinition: A scalar associated with a square matrix, zero exactly when the matrix is singular.

examples.en: We calculated the determinant to find out whether the small coefficient matrix was invertible.
examples.zh: 我们计算了「行列式」，以判断这个小系数矩阵是否可逆。

examples.en: The tutor asked how the determinant changed when we exchanged two rows of the example.
examples.zh: 老师问，交换例题中两行后「行列式」怎样变化。

collocations: check whether a determinant is zero

words.enDefinition: For an entry of a square matrix, the determinant obtained by deleting its row and column.

examples.en: We found a matrix minor by deleting the row and column containing the selected entry.
examples.zh: 我们删去选中元素所在的行和列，求得相应的「矩阵子式」。

examples.en: The tutor calculated the matrix minor before applying its sign in the determinant expansion.
examples.zh: 老师先计算「矩阵子式」，再在行列式展开中加上它的符号。

collocations: form a matrix minor by deleting a row and column
use a matrix minor in an expansion

words.enDefinition: The minor for a matrix entry multiplied by the sign determined by its row and column.

examples.en: The cofactor was negative because the minor was positive and the indicated sign was negative.
examples.zh: 子式为正、对应符号为负，所以「代数余子式」是负数。

examples.en: We paired each entry of the selected row with its cofactor before adding the terms.
examples.zh: 我们先把选定行的各元素与其「代数余子式」配对，再把各项相加。

collocations: find the sign of a cofactor
multiply an entry by its cofactor

words.enDefinition: Computing a determinant by summing products of entries in a chosen row or column and their cofactors.

examples.en: We used cofactor expansion along a column that contained two zeros to shorten the calculation.
examples.zh: 我们沿含两个零的一列做「余子式展开」，缩短计算过程。

examples.en: The tutor compared cofactor expansion along two different rows and checked that the determinant agreed.
examples.zh: 老师对比了沿两不同行的「余子式展开」，核查所得行列式是否一致。

collocations: choose a row for cofactor expansion
evaluate a determinant by cofactor expansion

words.enDefinition: To compute a determinant using entries and cofactors from one selected row.

examples.en: We chose to expand along a row with two zeros so only one term remained.
examples.zh: 我们选择「按一行展开」，该行有两个零，所以只剩一项。

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to expand along a row that had exactly one nonzero entry.
examples.zh: 练习表要求我们「按一行展开」，该行恰好只有一个非零元素。

collocations: expand along a row with zeros
choose to expand along a row
expand along a row of the matrix

words.enDefinition: The alternating pattern of positive and negative signs assigned to cofactors across the rows and columns.

examples.en: We wrote the checkerboard sign pattern beside the matrix before calculating the individual cofactors.
examples.zh: 我们先在矩阵旁写出「棋盘式符号排列」，再分别计算代数余子式。

examples.en: The tutor used the checkerboard sign pattern to explain why adjacent positions receive opposite signs.
examples.zh: 老师用「棋盘式符号排列」说明为什么相邻位置分配到相反的符号。

collocations: check a cofactor against the checkerboard sign pattern

words.enDefinition: The product of the entries on the main diagonal of a triangular matrix.

examples.en: We found the determinant of a triangular matrix by multiplying its three diagonal entries.
examples.zh: 我们将三个对角元素相乘，得出「三角矩阵的行列式」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed out that the determinant of a triangular matrix was zero in our example.
examples.zh: 老师指出，例题中的「三角矩阵的行列式」为零。

collocations: calculate the determinant of a triangular matrix
recognise the determinant of a triangular matrix from its diagonal
use the determinant of a triangular matrix after elimination

words.enDefinition: The rule that the determinant of a product of same-size square matrices equals the product of their determinants.

examples.en: We applied the multiplicative property of determinants instead of forming the full matrix product first.
examples.zh: 我们应用「行列式的乘法性质」，省去了先算整个矩阵乘积的步骤。

examples.en: The tutor used the multiplicative property of determinants to link the inverse's determinant to the original one.
examples.zh: 老师用「行列式的乘法性质」把逆矩阵的行列式与原矩阵的行列式联系起来。

collocations: apply the multiplicative property of determinants
verify the multiplicative property of determinants
use the multiplicative property of determinants for a product

words.zhGloss: 保持行列式不变的行变换
words.enDefinition: A row operation that leaves the determinant unchanged, such as adding a multiple of another row.
acceptedZhAnswers: 保持行列式不变的行变换

examples.en: We used a determinant-preserving row operation to create a zero before expanding along the column.
examples.zh: 我们用一个「保持行列式不变的行变换」得到一个零，再沿该列展开。

examples.en: The tutor asked which change counted as a determinant-preserving row operation in our example.
examples.zh: 老师问，例题中哪种操作属于「保持行列式不变的行变换」。

collocations: simplify a calculation with a determinant-preserving row operation

words.enDefinition: A rule solving a square nonsingular linear system using ratios of determinants with selected columns replaced.

examples.en: We used Cramer's rule to find one unknown after checking that the original determinant was nonzero.
examples.zh: 确认原行列式非零后，我们用「克拉默法则」求一个未知量。

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated Cramer's rule by replacing the relevant column with the right-hand side vector.
examples.zh: 老师用右端项向量替换相应的列，演示了「克拉默法则」。

collocations: solve a system using Cramer's rule
check the assumptions of Cramer's rule

words.enDefinition: The matrix whose products with the original square matrix in both orders give the identity.

examples.en: We verified the matrix inverse by multiplying it with the original in both orders.
examples.zh: 我们把「逆矩阵」与原矩阵分别按两种顺序相乘，验证了结果。

examples.en: The tutor used the matrix inverse to undo the effect of the first transformation.
examples.zh: 老师用「逆矩阵」消除第一个变换的作用。

words.enDefinition: A square matrix that has a two-sided inverse.

examples.en: The example used an invertible matrix so the transformation could be undone for every input.
examples.zh: 例题使用「可逆矩阵」，使任何输入对应的变换都可以还原。

examples.en: We checked every pivot column before deciding that the example contained an invertible matrix.
examples.zh: 我们核查了各主元列，才确定例题中的是一个「可逆矩阵」。

collocations: find the inverse of an invertible matrix
check whether a square matrix is invertible

words.enDefinition: A square matrix that does not have an inverse.

examples.en: The determinant was zero, so we identified the coefficient matrix on the worksheet as a singular matrix.
examples.zh: 行列式为零，因此我们判断习题中的系数矩阵是「奇异矩阵」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed out that the singular matrix had two identical columns in this example.
examples.zh: 老师指出，此例中的「奇异矩阵」有两列完全相同。

collocations: recognise a singular matrix from elimination
explain why a matrix is singular

words.enDefinition: A matrix that gives the identity when multiplied on the left of the specified matrix.

examples.en: We tested the left inverse by placing it before the rectangular matrix in the product.
examples.zh: 我们在乘积里把「左逆」放到矩形矩阵之前，以核查结果。

examples.en: The tutor explained why a left inverse could exist for a matrix with independent columns.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么列向量线性无关的矩阵可以有「左逆」。

words.enDefinition: A matrix that gives the identity when multiplied on the right of the specified matrix.

examples.en: We tested the right inverse by placing it after the original matrix before multiplying.
examples.zh: 我们将「右逆」放到原矩阵之后再相乘，以核查结果。

examples.en: The tutor explained why the matrix with independent rows could have a right inverse.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么行向量线性无关的矩阵可以有「右逆」。

collocations: check whether a right inverse exists

words.enDefinition: The theorem connecting equivalent tests for invertibility of a square matrix, such as full rank and trivial null space.

examples.en: We used the invertible matrix theorem to link a pivot in every column to invertibility.
examples.zh: 我们用「可逆矩阵定理」说明每一列都有主元为什么意味着可逆。

examples.en: The tutor chose one condition from the invertible matrix theorem to justify the conclusion without computing an inverse.
examples.zh: 老师从「可逆矩阵定理」中选了一个条件来证明结论，无需计算逆矩阵。

collocations: check a condition in the invertible matrix theorem
use the invertible matrix theorem to justify a conclusion

words.enDefinition: Finding an inverse by reducing an invertible matrix to identity while performing identical row operations on an appended identity.

examples.en: We computed the inverse by row reduction after writing the identity beside the original matrix.
examples.zh: 我们把单位矩阵写在原矩阵旁边，再「用行化简求逆」。

examples.en: The tutor found the inverse by row reduction and then checked the resulting product.
examples.zh: 老师「用行化简求逆」，随后核查所得乘积。

collocations: find the inverse by row reduction
check an inverse by row reduction
compute an inverse by row reduction from an augmented matrix

words.enDefinition: The transpose of the matrix of cofactors of a square matrix.

examples.en: We formed the adjugate matrix by transposing the table of cofactors from our calculation.
examples.zh: 我们对计算所得的代数余子式表作转置，形成「伴随矩阵」。

examples.en: The tutor divided the adjugate matrix by the nonzero determinant to obtain the inverse.
examples.zh: 老师将「伴随矩阵」除以非零行列式，得到逆矩阵。

collocations: form the adjugate matrix by transposing cofactors
use the adjugate matrix to find an inverse

words.enDefinition: The dimension of a matrix's column space, equal to the dimension of its row space.

examples.en: We found the rank of a matrix by counting the pivots in its echelon form.
examples.zh: 我们数行阶梯形中的主元个数，求出「矩阵的秩」。

examples.en: The rank of a matrix equals the size of its largest linearly independent set of columns.
examples.zh: 「矩阵的秩」等于最多能选出的线性无关列向量数。

collocations: determine the rank of a matrix
find the rank of a matrix from its pivots
compare the rank of a matrix before and after elimination

words.enDefinition: The dimension of the space spanned by the rows of a matrix.

examples.en: We calculated row rank by finding the number of nonzero rows after echelon reduction.
examples.zh: 我们化为行阶梯形后数非零行的个数，算出「行秩」。

examples.en: The tutor used row rank to describe how many independent constraints remained in the system.
examples.zh: 老师用「行秩」说明方程组剩下多少个线性无关的约束。

collocations: compare row rank with column rank
read row rank from echelon form

words.enDefinition: The dimension of the space spanned by the columns of a matrix.

examples.en: The column rank was two because exactly two columns formed a basis for the column space.
examples.zh: 由于恰有两列构成列空间的一组基，「列秩」为二。

examples.en: We compared the column rank of the matrix with its total number of columns.
examples.zh: 我们把矩阵的「列秩」与它的总列数作了对比。

collocations: compare the column rank with the row rank
find column rank using pivot columns

words.enDefinition: Rank equal to the smaller of the numbers of rows and columns.

examples.en: The rectangular matrix had full rank because its two independent rows matched the smaller dimension.
examples.zh: 这个矩形矩阵是「满秩」的，因为两行线性无关，和较小的维数相符。

examples.en: The tutor checked for full rank before asking whether the square example was invertible.
examples.zh: 问这个方阵例题是否可逆之前，老师先核查了它是否「满秩」。

collocations: explain why a matrix has full rank

words.enDefinition: The condition of a matrix having rank smaller than its maximum possible rank for its size.

examples.en: The example showed rank deficiency because only two pivots appeared in the three-by-three matrix.
examples.zh: 这个三行三列的矩阵只出现两个主元，例题体现了「秩亏」。

examples.en: We traced rank deficiency in the square example to one row being a multiple of another.
examples.zh: 我们查明，方阵例题中的「秩亏」源于有一行是另一行的倍数。

words.enDefinition: The dimension of the null space of a matrix or linear map.

examples.en: The nullity was two because two independent parameters described the solutions of the homogeneous system.
examples.zh: 两个独立参数描述了齐次方程组的解，所以「零度」为二。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how the nullity changed after a column was added to the matrix.
examples.zh: 老师问，给矩阵增加一列后「零度」发生了什么变化。

collocations: read the nullity from the free variables

words.enDefinition: Rank equal to the number of rows, making the rows linearly independent.

examples.en: The example had full row rank because each row had a pivot after echelon reduction.
examples.zh: 化为行阶梯形后每行都有一个主元，因此例题矩阵是「行满秩」的。

examples.en: We checked for full row rank before deciding whether every right-hand side could be reached.
examples.zh: 我们先核查是否「行满秩」，再判断能否得到任意右端项。

collocations: find a right inverse under full row rank

words.enDefinition: Rank equal to the number of columns, making the columns linearly independent.

examples.en: The matrix had full column rank because every variable column contained a pivot after elimination.
examples.zh: 消元后每个变量列都有一个主元，所以矩阵是「列满秩」的。

examples.en: The tutor related full column rank to the absence of free variables in the homogeneous system.
examples.zh: 老师把「列满秩」与齐次方程组中没有自由变量联系起来。

collocations: find a left inverse under full column rank

words.enDefinition: The set of all linear combinations of a matrix's rows.

examples.en: We used the nonzero rows of the echelon form as a basis for the row space.
examples.zh: 我们用行阶梯形的非零行作为「行空间」的一组基。

examples.en: The tutor showed that the row space stayed the same through the elementary row operations.
examples.zh: 老师说明，做初等行变换的过程中「行空间」保持不变。

collocations: choose a basis for the row space

words.enDefinition: The set of all linear combinations of a matrix's columns.

examples.en: The column space contained every output obtainable by multiplying the matrix by an input vector.
examples.zh: 通过矩阵乘输入向量得到的每个输出都在「列空间」中。

examples.en: We chose columns of the original matrix when building a basis for its column space.
examples.zh: 我们为「列空间」构造基时，从原矩阵中选取各列。

collocations: choose a basis for the column space

words.enDefinition: The set of input vectors that a matrix sends to the zero vector.

examples.en: We described the null space by solving the system with a zero right-hand side.
examples.zh: 我们通过解右端项为零的方程组，描述了「零空间」。

examples.en: The tutor checked whether the proposed vector belonged to the null space of the matrix.
examples.zh: 老师核查所提议的向量是否属于矩阵的「零空间」。

collocations: calculate the dimension of the null space

words.enDefinition: The space of vectors whose transposes give zero when multiplied on the left of a real matrix

examples.en: We found the left null space by solving the homogeneous system for the transposed matrix.
examples.zh: 我们求解转置矩阵对应的齐次方程组，得到「左零空间」。

examples.en: The tutor checked the left null space using a row vector multiplied on the left.
examples.zh: 老师用从左侧相乘的行向量来核查「左零空间」。

collocations: compute the dimension of the left null space

words.enDefinition: For a linear map with finite-dimensional domain, its rank plus its nullity equals the domain dimension.

examples.en: We used the rank-nullity theorem to find the nullity after counting three independent columns.
examples.zh: 我们数出三个线性无关的列，再用「秩—零度定理」求零度。

examples.en: The tutor used the rank-nullity theorem to check that both dimensions added up to the input dimension.
examples.zh: 老师用「秩—零度定理」核查两个维数之和是否等于输入空间的维数。

collocations: verify the rank-nullity theorem for a matrix
use the rank-nullity theorem to find a dimension

words.enDefinition: A set with addition and scalar multiplication satisfying the vector space axioms over a field.

examples.en: The class used polynomials to build a vector space in which the vectors were functions.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用多项式构造了一个「向量空间」，其中的向量是函数。

examples.en: Our new vector space came with rules for adding elements and multiplying them by scalars.
examples.zh: 这个新「向量空间」规定了如何将元素相加以及如何给元素乘以标量。

collocations: the zero vector of a vector space
a basis for a vector space

words.enDefinition: A vector space in which the scalars are real numbers.

examples.en: We used polynomials with real coefficients as our first example of a real vector space.
examples.zh: 我们用实系数多项式作为「实向量空间」的第一个例子。

examples.en: The instructor described how a real vector space can contain functions with real or complex values.
examples.zh: 老师讲解了「实向量空间」中的函数可以取实数值或复数值。

collocations: a basis for a real vector space
a real vector space of polynomials

words.enDefinition: The field whose elements are used as scalars in a vector space.

examples.en: We chose the real numbers as the field of scalars for the space of continuous functions.
examples.zh: 我们选实数作为连续函数空间的「标量域」。

examples.en: The teacher changed the field of scalars and asked us to check the dimension again.
examples.zh: 老师换了一个「标量域」，让我们重新核对维数。

words.enDefinition: One of the rules a space's vector addition and scalar multiplication must satisfy.

examples.en: Our tutor pointed out the vector space axiom that guarantees an additive inverse for each vector.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指出了保证每个向量都有加法逆元的那条「向量空间公理」。

examples.en: The group checked a vector space axiom by showing that changing parentheses did not affect addition.
examples.zh: 小组通过证明改变括号位置不影响加法，验证了一条「向量空间公理」。

words.enDefinition: A subset of a vector space that is itself a vector space under the inherited operations.

examples.en: The polynomials with zero constant term form a subspace of all polynomials in one variable.
examples.zh: 常数项为零的多项式构成一元多项式空间的一个「子空间」。

examples.en: She showed that the subset was a subspace by checking zero, scalar multiplication, and addition.
examples.zh: 她检查了零向量、数乘和加法，证明这个子集是一个「子空间」。

collocations: a subspace of a vector space

words.enDefinition: A test that checks whether a subset contains zero and is closed under addition and scalar multiplication.

examples.en: We used the subspace test to decide whether the functions vanishing at zero formed a space.
examples.zh: 我们用「子空间判定法」判断在零点取值为零的函数是否构成子空间。

examples.en: The collection failed the subspace test because adding two of its elements produced a vector outside it.
examples.zh: 这组向量未通过「子空间判定法」，因为其中两个向量相加，结果超出了这个集合。

words.enDefinition: The subspace containing only the zero vector.

examples.en: A basis for the zero subspace contains no vectors, so its dimension is zero.
examples.zh: 「零子空间」的基不含任何向量，因此其维数为零。

examples.en: The two spaces in our example intersected in the zero subspace, as predicted by the calculation.
examples.zh: 正如计算所示，例题中的两个空间相交于「零子空间」。

words.enDefinition: A subspace that is strictly smaller than its ambient vector space.

examples.en: The constant polynomials form a proper subspace of the polynomials of degree at most two.
examples.zh: 常数多项式构成次数不超过二的多项式空间的一个「真子空间」。

examples.en: The three vectors in the question spanned a proper subspace of the given four dimensional space.
examples.zh: 题中的三个向量张成给定四维空间的一个「真子空间」。

collocations: a proper subspace of the domain

words.enDefinition: Having the property that the sum of any two elements in the set also belongs to the set.

examples.en: The polynomials with zero constant term are closed under addition because their sums still vanish at zero.
examples.zh: 常数项为零的多项式「对加法封闭」，因为它们的和在零点仍取值为零。

examples.en: This set is not closed under addition because two odd integers always add to an even integer.
examples.zh: 这个集合不「对加法封闭」，因为两个奇数的和必为偶数。

collocations: prove a set is closed under addition
check whether a set is closed under addition

words.enDefinition: Having the property that multiplying any element by any scalar from the field gives another element of the set.

examples.en: Constant functions are closed under scalar multiplication because scaling one always gives another constant function.
examples.zh: 常值函数「对数乘封闭」，因为将任一常值函数乘以标量，结果仍是常值函数。

examples.en: The positive functions are not closed under scalar multiplication because a negative scalar changes their signs.
examples.zh: 取值为正的函数不「对数乘封闭」，因为乘以负标量会改变函数值的正负号。

collocations: prove a subspace is closed under scalar multiplication
be closed under scalar multiplication by real numbers
check whether a set is closed under scalar multiplication

words.enDefinition: The set of vectors formed by adding one vector from each of the subspaces.

examples.en: We found a basis for the sum of subspaces by combining their bases and removing redundant vectors.
examples.zh: 我们将各子空间的基合在一起，再去掉冗余向量，求得「子空间之和」的一组基。

examples.en: The worksheet compared the dimension of the sum of subspaces with the dimensions of its two parts.
examples.zh: 习题比较了「子空间之和」的维数与组成它的两个子空间各自的维数。

collocations: find a basis for a sum of subspaces
write a space as a sum of subspaces

words.enDefinition: The set of vectors that belong to every one of the given subspaces.

examples.en: The intersection of subspaces in our example contained exactly the vectors that satisfied both linear equations.
examples.zh: 在例子中，「子空间的交」恰好包含同时满足两个线性方程的向量。

examples.en: We showed that an intersection of subspaces always contains zero, even when it contains no other vector.
examples.zh: 我们证明「子空间的交」总包含零向量，即使其中没有其他向量。

collocations: compute the dimension of an intersection of subspaces

words.enDefinition: A sum of subspaces in which each vector has a unique expression as a sum of components from those subspaces.

examples.en: The class wrote the polynomial space as a direct sum of even polynomials and odd polynomials.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把多项式空间表示为偶多项式空间和奇多项式空间的「直和」。

examples.en: We recognized a direct sum when every vector split into a unique pair of components.
examples.zh: 当每个向量都能分解成唯一一对分量时，我们认出了这个「直和」。

collocations: write a space as a direct sum

words.enDefinition: A sum of vectors multiplied by scalar coefficients.

examples.en: She wrote one polynomial as a linear combination of a constant term and a quadratic term.
examples.zh: 她将一个多项式写成常数项和二次项的「线性组合」。

examples.en: The linear combination equaled zero when every coefficient was zero, as required by the example.
examples.zh: 正如例题要求，当所有系数均为零时，这个「线性组合」等于零。

collocations: write a vector as a linear combination

words.enDefinition: The subspace consisting of all finite linear combinations of the given vectors.

examples.en: The linear span of the constant and linear terms includes every polynomial of degree at most one.
examples.zh: 常数项和一次项的「张成空间」包含次数不超过一次的所有多项式。

examples.en: We checked the linear span of three columns by testing which vectors their combinations could produce.
examples.zh: 我们通过考察三个列向量的组合能得到哪些向量，来确定它们的「张成空间」。

collocations: the linear span of a set

words.enDefinition: A set of vectors whose linear combinations give every vector in the specified space.

examples.en: We removed the repeated vector and still had a spanning set for the same subspace.
examples.zh: 去掉重复向量后，剩下的仍是同一个子空间的「生成集」。

examples.en: The instructor asked for a spanning set of polynomials that included both constant and quadratic terms.
examples.zh: 老师要求写出一个由多项式组成的「生成集」，其中同时包含常数项和二次项。

collocations: a spanning set for the subspace
reduce a spanning set to a basis

words.enDefinition: Allowing only zero coefficients in any linear combination that equals zero.

examples.en: The first two columns were linearly independent because neither was a multiple of the other.
examples.zh: 前两个列向量「线性无关」，因为它们互不为倍数。

examples.en: We showed the polynomials were linearly independent by comparing coefficients after setting their linear combination to zero.
examples.zh: 我们令这些多项式的线性组合等于零，再比较各次幂的系数，证明它们「线性无关」。

collocations: prove the vectors are linearly independent

words.enDefinition: Admitting a zero linear combination with at least one nonzero coefficient.

examples.en: The three vectors were linearly dependent because the third was twice the first plus the second.
examples.zh: 三个向量「线性相关」，因为第三个是第一个的两倍加上第二个。

examples.en: Our set became linearly dependent after we added the zero vector to the two independent vectors.
examples.zh: 在两个独立的向量中加入零向量后，这个集合变成了「线性相关」的向量组。

collocations: show the vectors are linearly dependent

words.enDefinition: An equation giving a zero linear combination with coefficients that are not all zero.

examples.en: We found a linear dependence relation by subtracting the third vector from the sum of the others.
examples.zh: 我们从其余两个向量的和中减去第三个向量，找到了一个「线性相关关系」。

examples.en: Her linear dependence relation included two nonzero coefficients and showed that the columns were proportional.
examples.zh: 她写出的「线性相关关系」含有两个非零系数，说明两个列向量成比例。

collocations: write down a linear dependence relation

words.enDefinition: A linearly independent set that spans a vector space.

examples.en: We chose a basis with three polynomials that were independent and spanned the entire space.
examples.zh: 我们选了一组由三个多项式组成的「基」，它们线性无关且张成整个空间。

examples.en: The instructor found a basis by removing a redundant vector from the original spanning set.
examples.zh: 老师从原来的生成集中删除了一个冗余向量，得到一组「基」。

collocations: find a basis for a subspace
extend a set to a basis

words.enDefinition: An individual vector belonging to a basis.

examples.en: The first basis vector represented the constant term, while the second represented the linear term.
examples.zh: 第一个「基向量」对应常数项，第二个对应一次项。

examples.en: She used one basis vector twice and another once to reconstruct the vector in the example.
examples.zh: 她将一个「基向量」乘以二，再加上另一个基向量，重构出例题中的向量。

collocations: a linear combination of basis vectors

words.enDefinition: The usual basis of a coordinate vector space, with one entry equal to one and all others zero in each vector.

examples.en: The standard basis of the plane gave us one unit step along each positive coordinate axis.
examples.zh: 平面的「标准基」在每个坐标轴的正方向上各给出一个单位步长。

examples.en: Each vector in the standard basis of our coordinate space had exactly one nonzero entry.
examples.zh: 我们这个坐标空间的「标准基」中，每个向量恰好有一个非零元素。

collocations: the standard basis of a coordinate space
express a vector in the standard basis
the standard basis of the domain

words.enDefinition: The column of coefficients expressing a vector in a specified ordered basis.

examples.en: I wrote the coordinate vector for the polynomial by listing its coefficients in the specified basis order.
examples.zh: 我按指定的基顺序列出各系数，写出这个多项式的「坐标向量」。

examples.en: The vector itself stayed fixed, but its coordinate vector changed when we chose a different basis.
examples.zh: 向量本身未变，但换了一组基之后，它的「坐标向量」发生了变化。

collocations: a coordinate vector relative to a basis

words.enDefinition: The process of taking coordinates expressed in one basis and expressing them in another basis of the same space.

examples.en: A change of basis gave our polynomial new coordinates while its value at each point stayed fixed.
examples.zh: 「换基」让这个多项式有了新的坐标，但它在各点的取值都未变。

examples.en: We practiced a change of basis by expressing each vector again using a different set of basis vectors.
examples.zh: 我们用另一组基向量重新表示每个向量，练习了「换基」。

collocations: a change of basis in the domain

words.enDefinition: A matrix that converts coordinate columns for the same vector from one ordered basis to another.

examples.en: We built the change-of-basis matrix by writing each old basis vector in the new coordinates.
examples.zh: 我们把旧基中的每个向量写成新基下的坐标，构造了「换基矩阵」。

examples.en: The inverse of the change-of-basis matrix converted the coordinates back to the original basis in our example.
examples.zh: 在例题中，「换基矩阵」的逆矩阵把坐标换回到原来的基下。

words.enDefinition: The number of vectors in any basis of the vector space.

examples.en: We determined the dimension of a vector space by counting the vectors in a basis.
examples.zh: 我们数出一组基中有多少向量，从而确定了这个「向量空间的维数」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the dimension of a vector space stays the same for every basis.
examples.zh: 老师问，为什么不论选取哪一组基，「向量空间的维数」都相同。

collocations: determine the dimension of a vector space
show the dimension of a vector space is finite
compare the dimension of a vector space with that of a subspace

words.enDefinition: A vector space that has a basis consisting of finitely many vectors.

examples.en: Polynomials of degree at most three form a finite-dimensional vector space with four vectors in a basis.
examples.zh: 次数不超过三的多项式构成一个「有限维向量空间」，其每组基包含四个向量。

examples.en: The class represented each element of a finite-dimensional vector space by a list of four coordinates.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用四个坐标表示题目给出的「有限维向量空间」的每个元素。

collocations: choose a basis for a finite-dimensional vector space
a finite-dimensional vector space over the reals
work in a finite-dimensional vector space

words.enDefinition: A function between vector spaces over the same field that preserves vector addition and scalar multiplication.

examples.en: The class checked that taking the derivative defines a linear map on the space of polynomials.
examples.zh: 课堂验证了对多项式求导在多项式空间上定义了一个「线性映射」。

examples.en: A linear map sends the zero vector in its domain to the zero vector in its codomain.
examples.zh: 「线性映射」将定义域的零向量映射到陪域的零向量。

collocations: a linear map between vector spaces

words.enDefinition: The subspace of domain vectors that a linear map sends to zero.

examples.en: We identified the kernel of a linear map by solving for every vector sent to zero.
examples.zh: 我们求出所有被映为零向量的向量，确定了这个「线性映射的核」。

examples.en: The derivative example showed that the kernel of a linear map can consist of all constant polynomials.
examples.zh: 求导的例子说明，「线性映射的核」可以由所有常数多项式组成。

collocations: find the kernel of a linear map
a basis for the kernel of a linear map
the dimension of the kernel of a linear map

words.enDefinition: The subspace of the codomain consisting of all outputs of the linear map.

examples.en: We found the image of a linear map by taking the span of its basis vector outputs.
examples.zh: 我们把定义域的各基向量的输出取张成空间，求得了「线性映射的像」。

examples.en: The image of a linear map can have smaller dimension than the codomain written in the question.
examples.zh: 「线性映射的像」的维数可以小于题目给出的陪域的维数。

collocations: find the image of a linear map
belong to the image of a linear map
a basis for the image of a linear map

words.enDefinition: A matrix that expresses a linear map relative to chosen bases of its domain and codomain.

examples.en: We found the matrix representation by placing the output coordinates for each input basis vector in columns.
examples.zh: 我们将每个输入基向量的输出坐标按列排列，得到了「矩阵表示」。

examples.en: The matrix representation looked different when we chose a new basis for the codomain in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们给陪域选了一组新的基，映射的「矩阵表示」随之改变。

collocations: a matrix representation of a linear map

words.enDefinition: A linear map that gives a different output for every distinct input.

examples.en: We verified that the example was an injective linear map by showing that its kernel contained only zero.
examples.zh: 我们证明了例题中这个映射的核只含零向量，从而确认它是「单射线性映射」。

examples.en: The instructor used an injective linear map to place the polynomial space inside a larger coordinate space.
examples.zh: 老师用一个「单射线性映射」将多项式空间嵌入一个更大的坐标空间。

collocations: prove that a map is an injective linear map
the kernel of an injective linear map

words.enDefinition: A linear map whose outputs cover the entire codomain.

examples.en: Our example gave a surjective linear map because each vector in the codomain had at least one preimage.
examples.zh: 在我们的例子中，陪域中每个向量至少有一个原像，因此该映射是「满射线性映射」。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether dropping the last coordinate defines a surjective linear map onto the remaining coordinate space.
examples.zh: 老师问，去掉最后一个坐标是否定义了一个到其余坐标构成的空间的「满射线性映射」。

collocations: verify that a map is a surjective linear map
the codomain of a surjective linear map

words.enDefinition: A bijective linear map between two vector spaces.

examples.en: We built a linear isomorphism by sending each polynomial to its list of coefficients in order.
examples.zh: 我们把每个多项式映射成按顺序排列的系数列表，构造出一个「线性同构」。

examples.en: The inverse of a linear isomorphism takes each output back to its input and preserves linear operations.
examples.zh: 「线性同构」的逆映射将每个输出送回相应输入，并保持线性运算。

collocations: a linear isomorphism between two spaces
